description: Export a whole course, wait for Canvas to package it, then download the .imscc archive to local disk. Nothing in the course changes. Can take several minutes; use it before a term ends and access disappears.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

dest_dir.description: Local folder to save into. Defaults to the server's download folder (CANVAS_DOWNLOAD_DIR).

name: export_course_archive
title: Export Course Archive
